summary: Completed comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Econo Smart. All 14 backend pytest tests passed (auth, business CRUD, KPI math, status logic, simulator, AI analyze with Gemini, logout). Frontend critical flows all verified: login page renders with Google button, unauthenticated dashboard redirects to /login, cookie-based auth loads dashboard, empty state with sample/onboarding buttons appears, sample-data load displays all KPI cards (revenue, profit, margin, breakeven), health indicator shows 'Saludable', Recharts chart renders, Gemini AI recommendations render with strengths/risks/30-day plan, simulator presets work and Run produces correct +10% revenue delta, Editar datos navigates to /onboarding (all 9 form fields with data-testid present), and user-menu logout clears session and redirects to /login.

issues: First render of KPI cards momentarily clipped at top of viewport when dashboard mounts after sample-data load (cosmetic, scrolls into view immediately)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses datetime.utcnow vs datetime.now(timezone.utc) inconsistently between auth_session (creates session) and the test harness — works because get_current_user normalizes naive datetimes to UTC, but consider standardizing to timezone-aware throughout.
GEMINI_API_KEY committed in /app/backend/.env should be moved out of source control / rotated for production.
save_business uses 'biz.copy()' for insert which is fine, but the in-memory dict still mutates with 'kpis' added for response — acceptable since not re-saved.
/api/business/calculate is unauthenticated (no get_current_user) — minor: anyone can hit it to compute KPIs. Likely intentional for the onboarding preview, but worth confirming.
test_credentials: Created via MongoDB direct insert per /app/auth_testing.md. Backend tests use a session-scoped fixture; frontend test used token test_session_fe_1777163107832 (user FE Test User).
seed_data_creation: Test users + sessions created in MongoDB test_database (users, user_sessions). Sample business loaded via POST /api/business/sample. Test data prefixed with 'test-user-' and 'TEST_'; backend fixture cleans up automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints incl. live Gemini call — re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. For frontend auth-gated UI testing, create a session in MongoDB (see /app/auth_testing.md) then add cookie 'session_token' with domain='smart-finance-418.preview.emergentagent.com', secure=True, sameSite='None' BEFORE navigating. All key data-testids: google-login-button, kpi-revenue, kpi-profit, kpi-margin, kpi-breakeven, preset-price-up/cost-down/qty-up, run-simulation-btn, simulated-result-card, delta-revenue/profit/margin/breakeven, user-menu-trigger, logout-btn, input-business-name, select-business-type, input-monthly-sales/fixed-costs/cost-per-unit/sale-price/quantity-sold/inventory, submit-business-btn, load-sample-btn, empty-state-sample-btn.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. One transient ERR_CONNECTION_RESET observed in browser console during initial dashboard load — looks like a brief preview-environment network blip, not a code issue. Subsequent calls succeeded immediately.
